bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears released their first injury report of the week ahead of Sunday's home opener against Minnesota, with right tackle Darnell Wright, running back D'Andre Swift, and Kyle Monangai all appearing on the list after the Chicago Bears have released their first injury report of the week and it includes Darnell Wright, D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai, with Wright missing practice on Wednesday . Meanwhile, head coach Ben Johnson is bracing for a mental chess match with Minnesota's defense, as he admits he's currently in the process of trying not to overthink things when preparing for a matchup with Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions suffered a 41-31 road loss to the Buffalo Bills in their Week 2 Thursday Night Football matchup, dropping the high-scoring contest at Buffalo's new Highmark Stadium. Postgame analysis pointed to struggles up front for Detroit, though there was some positive news as an injury to a key player, believed to be Miller, is not expected to be long-term.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers are preparing for their Week 2 matchup against the New York Jets after a tough loss to the Vikings, with head coach Matt LaFleur discussing the team's approach against Jets quarterback Geno Smith during Thursday's practice. Packers coach Matt LaFleur talks about facing Geno Smith, New York Jets, while an injury report was also released as Green Bay continues preparations for the divisional road ahead.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings placed running back Jordan Mason on injured reserve this week following their Week 1 win over Green Bay, signing DeeJay Dallas from the practice squad to fill the roster spot ahead of Sunday's matchup against Chicago. Meanwhile, starting quarterback Kyler Murray remains in the concussion protocol after being injured against the Packers, with backup Carson Wentz set to lead the offense against the Bears while Murray's Week 2 status stays uncertain.
